title: Stage 4: Probes and resources
summary: Make the cluster understand when the API is healthy and how much it needs.

steps.title: Production settings
body: limits:   { memory: 512Mi }               # no CPU limit: avoid throttling
failureThreshold: 24                       # up to 2 minutes to start
httpGet: { path: /health/live, port: http }   # process only, no DB check
httpGet: { path: /health/ready, port: http }  # includes the DB check

steps.prompt: What QoS class do these API pods get?
steps.explain: Requests are set but do not equal limits (and there is no CPU limit), so Burstable.

steps.prompt: Complete the probes so a DB outage only takes pods out of rotation, never restarts them.
The startup probe runs every 5 s with `failureThreshold: 24`. How many seconds may the app take to start before it is restarted?

steps.title: Production readiness check
prompt: Write `List<string> Check(Container c)` for the record provided by the tests:
record Container(string? ReqCpu, string? ReqMem, string? LimMem, string? LivePath, string? ReadyPath, bool HasStartup);
1. `"missing cpu request"`, `"missing memory request"` (each if null)
2. `"missing memory limit"` if null; otherwise `"memory limit below request"` if both are set and the limit (in Mi) is smaller. Memory values are `NNMi` or `NNGi`.
3. `"missing readiness probe"`, `"missing liveness probe"` (each if null)
4. `"liveness and readiness use the same path"` if both are set and equal
solution: int Mi(string q) => q.EndsWith("Gi") ? int.Parse(q[..^2]) * 1024 : int.Parse(q[..^2]);
if (c.ReqCpu is null) problems.Add("missing cpu request");
if (c.ReqMem is null) problems.Add("missing memory request");
if (c.LimMem is null) problems.Add("missing memory limit");
else if (c.ReqMem is not null && Mi(c.LimMem) < Mi(c.ReqMem)) problems.Add("memory limit below request");
if (c.ReadyPath is null) problems.Add("missing readiness probe");
if (c.LivePath is null) problems.Add("missing liveness probe");
if (c.LivePath is not null && c.LivePath == c.ReadyPath) problems.Add("liveness and readiness use the same path");
template: Dojo.Eq("stage manifest passes", new List<string>(), Check(new Container("250m", "256Mi", "512Mi", "/health/live", "/health/ready", true)));
Dojo.Eq("bare container", new List<string> { "missing cpu request", "missing memory request", "missing memory limit", "missing readiness probe", "missing liveness probe", "no startup probe" },
Check(new Container(null, null, null, null, null, false)));
Dojo.Eq("limit below request (Gi vs Mi)", new List<string> { "memory limit below request" }, Check(new Container("1", "2Gi", "1536Mi", "/live", "/ready", true)));
Dojo.Eq("1Gi limit is fine for 1024Mi", new List<string>(), Check(new Container("1", "1024Mi", "1Gi", "/live", "/ready", true)));
Dojo.Eq("same path", new List<string> { "liveness and readiness use the same path" }, Check(new Container("1", "1Gi", "1Gi", "/health", "/health", true)));
record Container(string? ReqCpu, string? ReqMem, string? LimMem, string? LivePath, string? ReadyPath, bool HasStartup);
hints: Follow the list in order; each check adds at most one line.
